Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the director of "Blind Corner" as Lance Comfort (born 1908) without verifying if this was the correct film. There is another well-known film titled "Blind Corner" (1941) directed by George Pearson (born c. 1896), which is the more likely candidate given the era of "Cyclone of the Saddle" (1935). By assuming the 1964 film was the intended target without disambiguation, the Planner established a false premise. Consequently, the subsequent searches and comparisons were based on the wrong director, leading to an incorrect conclusion that Lance Comfort was born later.
